comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Shipped in workers 3.12; closing after 48h of stable production metrics.

content.text: Shipped in workers 3.12; closing after 48h of stable production metrics.
Multi-minute CSV/JSON exports leave the UI with a spinner and no intermediate feedback. Support tickets spike when users refresh and start a second export.

Workers writing export jobs may POST progress checkpoints {percent, rows_done, rows_estimated, updated_at} to an internal progress channel every ~5 seconds or every 2k rows, whichever comes first. The jobs API surfaces the latest checkpoint on GET /v2/jobs/{id}.
Acceptance: a 500k-row export updates percent at least 10 times before completion; failed jobs retain the last checkpoint; checkpoints older than 24h are pruned with the job row.
